picks.title: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar gives Google’s AI a face
picks.rationale: New Gemini Live Avatar gives the assistant an animated face that switches across 97 languages, a fresh on-device AI interface release.
picks.excerpt: The AI avatar can transition between 97 languages.

picks.title: Meta puts its AI assistant on a keychain
picks.rationale: Connect pick 1 of 2: Muse Charm is a brand-new keychain-sized AI hardware form factor shipping in December, distinct from yesterday's Muse-on-glasses leak.
picks.excerpt: Meta says the keychain-sized Muse Charm will ship in December.

picks.title: Meta Pinky Promises Its Smart Glasses Will Be Private Soon
picks.rationale: Connect pick 2 of 2: Private Processing encryption coming to Meta's AI glasses addresses the category's biggest privacy concern, a new angle not yet covered.
picks.excerpt: The company is bringing its Private Processing encryption service to its much-maligned smart glasses.

picks.title: Google Photos' new Redact tool will make it easy to hide sensitive information
picks.rationale: Actionable new AI-powered Redact tool in Google Photos that blurs sensitive parts of an image in one step, useful for anyone sharing screenshots.
picks.excerpt: Google Photos’ new AI-powered features include the Redact tool, which can quickly blur parts of an image.

picks.title: Apple vs. Adobe: How does iOS 27’s AI photo editing compare to Photoshop?
picks.rationale: Hands-on test of iOS 27 Clean Up and Extend against Photoshop with real photos, directly relevant to how creatives choose AI editing tools.
picks.excerpt: How does Apple’s new iOS 27 Clean Up and Extend compare to Photoshop? I tested both with real photos to find out.
